h:
我绝不是专家，希望得到任何反馈或额外的想法。我花了一些时间修改 Animate Diff 工作流程，专门用于变形和转换 GIF 和动画。

大声疾呼懒狗感谢让我走上这条道路的出色工作流程。 (Animatediff 工作流程：ComfyUI 中的 Openpose 关键帧 - 3 个关键帧 v1.1 |稳定的扩散工作流程 |奇维泰）

我并不总是使用所有节点。潜在高档真的有助于平滑运动。即使使用高档设备，远处的面孔也会变形，而 ReActor 似乎使面孔看起来很漂亮。我认为这里还有一些改进的地方！

我正在使用 ControlNet Tile 来处理图像。我将使用 Photoshop 使它们之间的背景相似。我发现较低的 ControlNet 权重为 Txt2Vid 提供了喘息的空间，但经常使用强度权重。

o.en:
I am by no means an expert and would love any feedback or additional thoughts. I have spent a bit of time tinkering with Animate Diff workflows specifically for morphs and transformation GIF's and animations.

Shoutout toa1lazydogfor the excellent workflow that set me down this path. (Animatediff Workflow: Openpose Keyframing in ComfyUI - 3 keyframes v1.1 | Stable Diffusion Workflows | Civitai)

I don't use all nodes at all times. Latent upscalereallyhelps smooth motion. Distant faces get warped even with upscale and ReActor seems to make the faces look nice. I think there is some refining to do here!

I am using ControlNet Tile for images. I will use Photoshop to make backgrounds similar between them. I have found that low ControlNet weights give the Txt2Vid room to breathe but often play with the strength weights.
